events.name: Theydon Bois Christmas lights and market
events.description: Friday 27 November: Christmas lights and the primary school choir at the Village Hall at 5pm, followed by the village Christmas market from 5.30pm to 8pm.

events.name: Waltham Abbey Cavalcade of Light
events.description: The Cavalcade of Light takes place on Friday 27 November. Check the council listing for the route and timings.

events.name: Epping Christmas Market
events.description: Friday 4 December, noon to 8pm: a traditional Christmas market with entertainment, food, gifts, crafts, Santa and festive fun.

events.name: Highams Park Christmas Fayre
events.description: Sunday 6 December, 11am to 5pm: a free Christmas fayre for all the family. Check the community calendar for locations and activities.

events.name: Loughton Christmas Fair and Market
events.description: Sunday 6 December, noon to 3pm: free entry to the Staples Road School PTA Christmas fair, with stalls, games, performances and refreshments from the 41st Epping Forest Scouts.

events.name: Waltham Abbey Christmas Market
events.description: Saturday 12 December, 9am to 3pm: Christmas market on Sun Street and Market Square.

events.name: North Chingford Christmas Market
events.description: Saturday 19 December, 11am to 4pm: free-entry market with more than 30 stalls, live entertainment and community carols. Santa’s grotto supports The Dream Factory and requires a separate advance booking.

events.name: The Bull Christmas Market
events.description: Saturday 28 November from noon: festive stalls and live music at The Bull in Wanstead.

events.name: Charity Christmas Bazaar
events.description: Saturday 28 November from 10:30am: a charity Christmas bazaar at Woodford Memorial Hall, with tickets to visit Santa available at extra cost.
